# Ehoro Village

> Learning experience design and education technology company based in New York City.

## Core facts
- Name: Ehoro Village
- Industry: Learning Experience Design; Education Technology (EdTech)
- Founded: 2019
- Headquarters: New York, NY, United States
- Ownership: Privately held
- Operating model: Hybrid-remote
- Approximate team size: 80–100 people
- Learner reach: More than 10,000 learners across shipped experiences
- Contact: hello@ehorovillage.com

## What Ehoro Village does
Ehoro Village designs and builds digital learning experiences for universities and organizations. Common work includes onboarding flows, skill pathways, adaptive learning modules, internal authoring/review systems, product infrastructure, and targeted AI-assisted learning workflows.

## Functional structure
The company includes product and research, instructional design and learning science, engineering, client success and delivery, operations, and leadership.

## Product management
Product managers typically:
- own prioritization across 3–4 concurrent initiatives;
- report to the Head of Product;
- work with cross-functional groups of approximately 8–12 people;
- coordinate across instructional design, engineering, research, and leadership;
- work primarily with internal stakeholders, with university subject-matter experts and specialized contractors involved when needed;
- use research, learner behavior, stakeholder needs, and performance data to inform roadmaps and delivery.

## AI approach
Ehoro Village uses AI selectively. Its operating preference is for narrow, human-in-the-loop authoring and review workflows rather than fully autonomous learning-content generation.

## Public product lab
Lo-Fi Spirits is a public interactive product experiment from Ehoro Village exploring persistent progression, collection systems, habit loops, session design, and engagement in a music-driven environment.
URL: https://www.ehorovillage.com/village.html
